info.name: About Sasha
info.plot: Trasferitasi in un’altra città, Sasha cambia scuola. La sua personalità misteriosa e carismatica lascia un’impressione duratura ovunque vada. Come per ogni adolescente, nuove amicizie, flirt con i ragazzi e litigi con i genitori fanno parte della quotidianità. In quanto persona intersessuale, sposa di nuovo il suo lato femminile, ma sente di dover nascondere la sua diversità agli altri.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: It's Sasha's first day in 12th grade in her new high school. Her reason she's arriving mid-year is a secret kept hidden at all costs. Not an easy feat when her new group of friends is bombarding her with questions! Her little sister Pauline must also try to fit into this new life that Sasha has enforced on the whole family.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: Sasha tries to find her feet within this new group of friends who are giving her a hard time. Not easy, especially when Anna invites her to her birthday party - a rare privilege as it's only open to a select few. However, Sasha's parents insist she takes Pauline with her. It's not a good idea as her sister is known for being a chatterbox!

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: Sasha and Pauline are pouting at each other after the birthday party. Things go even more downhill when Anna invites herself to a sleepover at Sasha's, which could jeopardize her secret. Nothing goes as planned.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: Sasha wants to undergo a medical procedure to fix her problem, but her parents aren't exactly keen on the idea. It looks even more compromised when the doctor tending to Sasha is fiercely opposed to her decision.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: Sasha ha finalmente raggiunto la velocità di crociera con il suo nuovo gruppo di amici. Sta persino iniziando ad avvicinarsi ad Alex, fino al punto di dimenticare che Pauline ha più che mai bisogno di lei adesso che sta per partecipare alla sua gara di pattinaggio artistico. Anna vede le cose diversamente. Crede che Alex appartenga a lei e a nessun'altra.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: Sasha did something stupid, putting her life at risk. She refuses to tell anyone about it, especially Alex, who has just invited her to "review" their schoolwork at his house. Will she move things up a notch with Alex?

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: Sasha's old bad memories come back to haunt her one afternoon while she's at the pool with her friends. Things are tenser than ever with Alex. Lost and with no one to confide in, she tries to find answers from others who, like her, are hiding a dark secret.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: Devastated by Sasha's coldness, Anna goes to her and decides to make a startling revelation. But is Sasha ready to hear it?

episodes.name: Episodio 9
episodes.plot: Everyone in high school is now in the know about Sasha's secret. As the oral exams slowly approach, Sasha might have to make some difficult decisions.

episodes.name: Episodio 10
episodes.plot: Finalmente è arrivato il giorno dell'esame orale. Sasha usa il tempo per fare il punto di tutto quello che ha vissuto negli ultimi mesi.

translations.title: About Sasha
translations.overview: Sasha tries to start a new life in a new school after she learns that she is intersex. However, it turns out to be more difficult than expected to navigate both high school and a body that her peers don't understand.

Sasha, c’est la nouvelle du lycée. Or, jusqu’à il y a quelques mois, Sasha était un garçon sans histoire. Ses problématiques étaient les mêmes que celles des adolescents de son âge. Mais Sasha a appris qu’on lui ment depuis sa naissance : elle est née avec un corps ni tout à fait fille ni tout à fait garçon. Un corps intersexe. Entre les médecins, qui n’ont eu de cesse de vouloir la « réparer », et ses parents, qui le lui ont toujours caché « pour la protéger », Sasha est terrifiée et en colère. Elle n’a désormais qu’une idée en tête : partir à la rencontre de son identité.
